For a training molecule that is itself an anchor, set its self-similarity column to 0 so it does not leak its own label. Fit the same LightGBM on the residual r with these augmented features. Leave the GP and blend unchanged.
backlog.title: Anchor-similarity features for the descriptor LightGBM

backlog.spec: Replace the GP member with a relevance-vector / ARD linear model on the 2048 Morgan bit vectors. Fit the residual r with per-weight precisions alpha_j and noise precision beta, using MacKay's fixed-point updates for about 50 iterations (alpha_j = gamma_j / mu_j^2, where gamma_j = 1 - alpha_j Sigma_jj). Prune weights whose alpha_j exceeds 1e8, and predict with the posterior mean on the test bits plus base_te. Initialise beta from the residual variance, and set alpha_j = 1 at the start. Use it as a third blend member alongside the descriptor LightGBM and the GP, with equal rank weights.
backlog.title: Sparse Bayesian ARD regression on Morgan bits

backlog.spec: Build log1p of the Morgan count fingerprint (radius 2, 2048 bits) for the training and test molecules. Fit sklearn LassoCV (5 folds, inner KFold with shuffle and random_state=seed, a 30-value alpha path) on the residual r. Predict test as the model output plus base_te. Rank-average this with the existing descriptor and GP members at weight 0.2, and shrink the other two to 0.4 each. The point is a sparse, selection-driven linear view of substructure counts, which is distinct from the earlier ridge and ElasticNet members.
backlog.title: Pathwise Lasso on log1p Morgan counts as a sparse linear member

backlog.spec: Before ranking, divide each training label by the number of heavy atoms raised to a power of 0.5 (or a log-based divisor) to remove the size confound, then rank the normalised values and divide by n as before. Fit all models on this rank target. At prediction time, return the model output directly, since the test molecules are also ranked within the same family. Do not multiply back by size. Keep the physchem OLS prior and the rest of the pipeline unchanged. This is a single change to the target transform in fit_predict.
backlog.title: Heavy-atom-normalised rank target

backlog.spec: Fit a ridge regression on the Morgan bit vectors (alpha = 10) that predicts a standardised subset of 30 RDKit descriptors, using the training molecules only. Then predict those 30 descriptors for the test molecules. Append the predicted values to the real descriptor matrix for the LightGBM fit on the residual, and use the true descriptors for the training rows. This adds a learned, smoother view of the size and polarity axes. Keep everything else unchanged. Unlike the autoencoder idea, the targets are known chemical descriptors, not a learned bottleneck.
backlog.title: Fingerprint-predicted descriptors as auxiliary features

backlog.spec: Replace the single descriptor LightGBM with three fits of the same model at learning rates 0.01, 0.03 and 0.1, with n_estimators scaled inversely (1200, 400, 120) so the total shrinkage is matched. Use different subsample seeds, derived from the seed argument. Average the three predictions by rank, and then keep the existing rank blend with the GP. The idea is to hedge the shrinkage schedule rather than pick one value, which is more robust than a single tuned rate.
backlog.title: Learning-rate ladder across an ensemble of descriptor LightGBM fits

backlog.spec: Replace the single OLS fit of the rank target on [1, MolLogP, TPSA] with a jackknife average. For each unique Murcko scaffold group in the training fold, fit the OLS with that group left out, and average the resulting beta vectors over all groups. Use the averaged beta to form base_tr and base_te, then compute the residual as before. The aim is to reduce the influence of any single scaffold on the prior, with no other changes to the pipeline.
backlog.title: Leave-one-scaffold-group-out jackknife of the physchem prior

cand.description: Adds a sparse Bayesian ARD linear model on the 2048 Morgan bits (MacKay fixed-point updates, 50 iterations, Woodbury form in sample space, pruning alpha > 1e8) as a third member, rank-averaged with equal weights alongside the descriptor LightGBM and the Tanimoto GP.

incumbent.description: Regress the rank target on Crippen MolLogP and TPSA by OLS with an intercept, fit the descriptor LightGBM and the Tanimoto GP on the residuals, and add the linear baseline back to their test predictions before the rank blend.
